collection.description: A master criticizes an apprentice's work too sharply in front of others.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (master), a master, criticizes an apprentice's work too sharply in front of others.

choices.label: Ask the Apprentice What Support Would Help

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (apprentice) asks (master) not to repeat the public criticism.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (apprentice) feels uncomfortable being singled out again.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (master) realizes the task was poorly explained.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (apprentice) asks to work with a different teacher for a while.
